retention.comment: for ELF/BIN payloads. protected_fallback entries in payload_registry.json are always kept in hosted regardless of these numbers

pkg_retention.comment: same rules as 'retention' but scoped to pkgs/ + pkg_registry.json

ffpfsc_retention.comment: same rules as 'retention' but scoped to ffpfsc/ + ffpfsc_registry.json

portable_tools.comment: Optional. PLUZ check verifies these paths exist if set. Leave null to skip a check (e.g. tool is on system PATH via pacman/apt/portable WinPython, or you're using PLUZ.pyz which needs only python3). Examples: Arch '/home/you/portaz/git-portable/bin/git', Windows 'D:\\portaz\\Git-p\\bin\\git.exe'.

platform_field_note: Optional per-entry field. Absent = ps5. Values: ps5 | ps4 | ps4/ps5
manifest_fw_fields: fw_min and fw_max are optional strings (e.g. '3.00', '12.70'). Absent = no restriction.

hw_targets.comment: Optional per-entry 'hw_target' field in every registry. Absent/null = not stated (never guessed).
hw_targets.P5U: universal: optimized for both PS5 and PS5 Pro
